title: Increasing Max Linear Velocity
statement: Increasing the maximum linear velocity of the robot will reduce the total duration of the mission, thereby optimizing navigation speed and minimizing transit time.
mechanism: By allowing the robot to move faster, the overall time required to complete the mission is reduced, assuming the increased speed does not lead to more frequent or severe collisions.
